As we all know, the stated face balance is $12 million, our preliminary internal worksheet has us at an $8 million bid for the full portfolio, and the seller's draft process closes this Friday. Before we submit anything binding, I'll need sign-off from credit risk, loan operations, and compliance. I'd like to hear from each of you on where we stand and whether there are any issues I should be aware of before I approve our final bid and transaction conditions.
